occurrence_sentence: Hyper Intelligence, Inc. announces the launch of quantum-inspired algorithm that enhances how Large Language Models operate on AI infrastructure.

Hyper Intelligence is the second spin-out of [Entanglement](https://streaklinks.com/Buyib_vNjYRIfmR_wABtpATp/https%3A%2F%2Fwww.entanglement.ai%2F) and this launch follows the launch of Entanglement Inc.'s first spin-out [seQure](https://streaklinks.com/Buyib_zKiizFWPOCRA5-o2iy/https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sequre.ai%2F), an enterprise zero-trust cybersecurity and data observability company ensuring the safety of Fortune 100 companies, government, and critical infrastructure customers.
